candidates.yourNature_desc: You hold the tall tree's patience more than its hunger. The push comes in seasons now, and between them the vision just sits in you, waiting for weather. When the growing starts it runs slower than you'd like and truer than you expect. Spring has never once missed a year. Yours simply keeps its own calendar.

self_card.presence: The push comes in seasons, not as a constant. On the days it arrives you move like spring. On the others, you're allowed to be winter.
